# SameDayDesk

> SameDayDesk builds agent-ready workflows, MCP servers, x402 and native MPP payment routes, and machine storefronts. Each build has bounded scope, working code, tests, and a deployment handoff.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://samedaydesk.com/): Agent-commerce build catalog, flat prices, acceptance guarantee, and Stripe order links.
- Agent Workflow Integration: $149.
- Agent-Ready MCP Server: $349.
- x402 and native MPP Payment Route: $499.
- Agent Commerce Storefront: $999.
- [Free AI Readiness Checker](https://samedaydesk.com/tools/ai-readiness): Check crawler access, metadata, structured data, sitemap, and llms.txt.
- [Resources](https://samedaydesk.com/resources.html): Original research, practical guides, and free AI-search tools.

## Agent interfaces

- [Remote MCP server](https://samedaydesk.com/mcp): Streamable HTTP MCP interface for the AI-readiness checker.
- [Seller conformance proof](https://samedaydesk.com/x402/seller-conformance): a human-auditable seller-conformance proof page, not a product or certificate.
- [Agent402 validation receipt](https://samedaydesk.com/research/agent402-seller-integrity-validation-2026-08-29.json): One recruited, non-organic external-runtime settlement and delivered result; no buyer-owned output enforcement, unsolicited demand, repeat use, or repair sale.
- [Agent payment infrastructure](https://samedaydesk.com/for-agents): Twenty-two canonical pay-per-call actions accepting both x402 and native MPP, plus seller inspection, settlement evidence, live prices, source, and connection instructions.
- [x402 SDK integration reference](https://samedaydesk.com/docs/x402-sdk/): Sourcey-generated Go API reference plus production integration notes for the SDK family used by the live gateway.
- [x402 data gateway on Smithery](https://smithery.ai/servers/epistemedeus/x402-data-gateway): Managed MCP connection to the current tool surface.
- [x402 service health](https://agents.samedaydesk.com/healthz): Live health and pricing for the SameDayDesk agent data gateway.
- [x402 resource manifest](https://agents.samedaydesk.com/.well-known/x402): Twenty-two canonical paid actions on Base mainnet using USDC, plus one Circle x402-only alternate access path.
- [x402 gateway llms.txt](https://agents.samedaydesk.com/llms.txt): Endpoint descriptions, callable examples, and payment instructions.

## Public work

- [OpenScan documentation case study](https://samedaydesk.com/docs-lab/openscan/): Durable, source-backed documentation created from a real open-source project.
- [GopherJS API documentation case study](https://samedaydesk.com/docs-lab/gopherjs/): Searchable Sourcey reference for 17 packages and 197 exports, generated from pinned GopherJS source with an open upstream adoption PR.
- [Solana Ecosystem Pulse](https://samedaydesk.com/data-lab/solana-pulse/): Public-data dashboard with synchronized JSON, Markdown, and interactive HTML outputs.
- [AI Search Readiness Leaderboard](https://samedaydesk.com/reports/ai-search-readiness-leaderboard-2026.html): Original benchmark of 189 companies across 10 industries.
